csv_project_name: Design Service for Prototype Park Master Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Henderson, Nevada, is requesting professional planning and design services for the Prototype Park Master Plan Project. The approximately 9.5-acre site is located at 1640 Price Street and is currently the existing Wells Park (APN s 17801310058, 17801304001, 17801799001, 17801701001, and a portion of 17801701002). The focus will be the development of a master plan that includes awareness of sustainable practices for the project site as well as future City of Henderson parks. An environmental assessment will need to be completed as part of the project.
